title: Love It
text: Love It. Great table that fits in small spaces and helps when you are far from an outlet

product_metadata.title: Rolanstar End Table with Charging Station & 2 USB Ports, Side Table with Drawer and Shelf, Narrow End Table with Large Storage, Sofa Side Table Sturdy Bedside Table for Living Room Grey
features: 【End Table with Drawer & Large Storage】The end table have one drawer with handle offers ample room for storing private or other stuff you want to put inside, the top and bottom open shelf gives sufficient storage room for storing and displaying, This nightsand is an excellent addition to any space for keeping the room free of clutter.

【Side Table with Charging Station & Power By Your Side】The end table with charging station have two standard outlets and two USB ports which can easily charge your phone, tablet, and even your laptop. 6.5ft long power supply cord allows you to move this end table freely, you can power by your side

【Multiple Use Storage Narrow Side Table】Perfect design meets modern convenience in this nightstand, a perfect pick for your bedroom, living room, home office... This slim nightstand can be used as a bedside table, couch table, or you can place plants, decorations or books in narrow corners.
【Stable and Strong】The beside have a robust steel frame, premium particleboard panels, and adjustable feet, this side table will support your items firmly and reliably
【Easy & Fast Setup and Clean】 Following the instruction and using the tools provided assembly complete effortlessly within 30mins!
